description: Memory: Remove a key. Free within your daily limit. Needs a hosted identity (create_identity).

key.description: 1 to 256 bytes of letters, digits, . _ / - without ..

max_cost.description: optional: your ceiling in memory_bytes; a higher price is refused and nothing is spent. Left out, the quote for the arguments is the ceiling

request_id.description: optional: your retry key for this exact call, unique among your identity's commands. A retry with the same request_id and arguments is never run or charged twice: within the minute it returns the first answer, later it is 409 idempotency_conflict

name: memory_delete
title: Memory delete
